[b]Montfleur the Grand and Wonderful[/b]
As the world churned into wars and conflict, the Kingdom of Montfleur stood silently, watching over it all. Within the kingdom a new president of the state had been appointed, the Duchess of Vierne, a technocractic populist, who had once dated the king. Nevertheless in just a few months she had quietly begun to restructure the government to ensure the creation of an Agenda 2030, which laid out the goals for major economic and social expansions in Montfleur and abroad, hopefully lifting the country from the decades long stagnation it had undergone since decolonisation had completed in 1987.

[i]The Republic of Daesun proudly announces the beginning of Duponal mining operations on the celestial body of Dupont. The Federal Aeronautics and Space Organization(FASO)  has confirmed the launch of the DSA-II [b]Bugsae[/b] shuttle in the equatorial province of [b]Myeotan[/b] at 08:40 AM Euncheon Time (HST±12). 

DSA-II utilized a three stage heavy launch rocket, hauling multiple autonomous mining drones (AMDs) and solar energy power stations. 3 minutes after liftoff at 08:44, Bugsae exited its first stage, releasing the SRBs and entering the second stage within the atmosphere. Bugsae continued in stage 2 relatively unbothered, accelerating towards orbit and stabilizing trajectory with the assistance of the Byeogun and onboard computing systems, constantly recalculating and adjusting trajectory and course. At 08:52, Bugsaes second stage booster burned out, releasing and descending down towards the Erene. Bugsae was now within low Erene orbit, and could now initiate the transduponal stage, from the rear of the bow activated small rockets operated by liquid fueled engine efficiently drove the Bugsae through the vacuum of space, hauling the final journey to Dupont. 

After 3 days of continuous flight, Bugsae reached within landing distance of Dupont, and could transition into low Dupont Orbit, stabilizing its gradual descent with thrusters and AN systems. Once Bugsae had completed its landing, it would release its payload of multiple AMD and utility rovers, assisting the shuttle in setting up the solar power bank. After the power bank was set up and operational, FASO central command dispatched a small group of miniature tracer drones that traversed through the harsh Duponal terrain towards set Helium-3 sites. Mining operations were to be set once sufficient information on routes, sites, and optimal solar positioning were obtained. 

After the successful launch and deployment of AMDs onto Dupont, president of the Federal Aerosonautics and Space Organization [b]Yun Seung-ah[/b] would release a nationwide address about the success of the Bugsae. 

At 14:00 Euncheon Time,Yun would walk the podium at the FASO regional headquarters to deliver her speech. [b]Today, my fellow Daesunites, marks a historic moment for our Republic. Our dedication, ingenuity, and vision have brought us to this day. Daesun is now the first nation to begin Duponal mining for helium-3, a vital resource that will play a key role in powering the nuclear future of our Republic and advancing our technological ambitions. This success could not have been achieved without the tireless efforts of our scientists, engineers, technicians, and countless others. That is why I personally thank each of you for proving today that, united, we are unfaltering, unbreakable, and unbeatable. Shall we look towards the stars, with ambition in our hearts, and dedication in our minds. Thank you all.[/b]

With the success of the Bugsae mission and the initiation of Duponal mining operations, the Daesunite Ministry of Commerce and Interior had approved the distribution of selective, performance based subsidies to domestic aerospace firms participating in the helium-3 sector. A total of [b]$20 billion USD[/b] in targeted investments will be allocated toward the development of autonomous mining drones (AMDs), supporting companies that demonstrate technological efficiency, reliability, and long-term market competitiveness within the emerging helium-3 industry. The plan will also work to foster the development of its Nuclear energy sector, mainly through wider-range scholarships for students studying in aerospace, nuclear engineering, and sophisticated AI computing, and additional funding to the educational STEM program. Daesunite firms operating within the specific fields of Nuclear Energy, Duponal Mining, and AI shall also receive set tax breaks in return for agreed Sunset clauses and export licensing to ensure transparency and exports safety. FASO sources estimate that Duponal mining operations could begin as early as late 2027 if the DSA-II economic plan succeeds. 
[/i]
[/spoiler]
